pkgmetadata.longdescription: Provides the open-source LiteLLM SDK, all three command entrypoints, the default Uvicorn gateway, basic configuration and model routing, and health endpoints. It intentionally excludes MCP, custom-code guardrails, Gunicorn and Granian, Focus and Polars integrations, profiling, optional queue integrations, enterprise code, SSO, and optional cloud-provider SDKs. The default local proxy includes Prisma migrations and PostgreSQL 18 server support, with systemd support following the profile USE flag. Boto3 and Redis are retained only because the minimal gateway imports them during startup; their presence does not enable the full optional cloud-provider or queue integration scope.
